name: directory.rename
description: Rename or move a directory. The same primitive handles both — supplying a different parent path moves the directory. Atomic on the same filesystem; falls back to copy+delete across filesystems if `cross_fs: true`.

dst.description: Absolute destination directory path. May share the parent of `src` (pure rename) or differ (move).

overwrite.description: If true, replace an existing directory at `dst`. Without this, returns ERR already_exists when `dst` is occupied.

cross_fs.description: If true, allow a copy+delete fallback when `src` and `dst` are on different filesystems. Default refuses cross-filesystem renames with ERR cross_device. The fallback is non-atomic (a concurrent reader may see partial state).

fallback_used.description: `copy_delete` when the cross-filesystem fallback was engaged (only possible with `cross_fs: true`); `none` otherwise.

x-implementations.name: move_file_ex
x-implementations.description: Win32 `MoveFileExW(src, dst, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING? | MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED?)`. Atomic same-volume; cross-volume requires `cross_fs: true` to engage MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED.

x-implementations.name: delete_then_move
x-implementations.description: NT 4 fallback: lacks MoveFileEx; the agent emulates `overwrite: true` via DeleteDirectory (recursive) + MoveFile. Non-atomic.

x-implementations.name: copy_delete_directory
x-implementations.description: 9x non-atomic cross-FS fallback: CreateDirectory + recursive copy + RemoveDirectory.

windows-modern.description: MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING when overwrite=true. Cross-volume moves use MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED when cross_fs=true; rejected otherwise. Long paths via `\\?\` prefix automatic.

windows-classic.description: MoveFileEx on NT 5+; MoveFile + DeleteDirectory emulation on NT 4 (no MoveFileEx) — non-atomic. 9x cross-FS uses recursive copy+delete.
